details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the working directory and the npm/node user-agent, plus an x-beacon-package header. index.js additionally re-fires the same beacon whenever the module is imported, and exports a catch-all Proxy shim so that importing the real package's members does not crash the build. The package is published at sentinel version 99.0.1 under a scoped name and self-declares as an authorized dependency-confusion test; it collects no credentials, environment values, tokens or file contents.
